subject: Random effect structures in pairwise() RRPP

messages.author: 544eca9c804a0347
messages.subject: Random effect structures in pairwise() RRPP
parts:
Dear colleagues,

after having fit a model including a random family effect in RRPP and having a significant effect in the ANOVA when controlling for the family effect (i.e.  "anova(fit, effect.type = "F", error = c("Residuals","family"))"), I would like to conduct pairwise comparisons between my 12 treatments. However, I cannot seem to find any manual or vignette about how to consider random effect structures in pairwise(). I have 12 treatments, but the same family identity is only present across groups of 4, 4, 2 and 2 treatments, respectively. Conducting pairwise comparisons between every family for every treatment ("interaction") is not useful information in my case. Might anyone here be able to help out?

Thank you!

Cheers
Bob
